snippet.title: FEE3 2024: Life of Seiros by Augenis
snippet.description:
In the beginning, amid the great
cloudless ocean, Fódlan came to be.
At the end of a long journey, Sothis
glimpsed that land and there alighted.
With her blood, she birthed offspring, and
shared her gifts with all of humanity.
Yet, not all of humanity was thankful…

Life of Seiros is a work in progress romhack set in the ancient past of Fire Emblem: Three Houses, and aims to retell the beginnings of two heroes - Rhea, or Saint Seiros, and Wilhelm, the first Emperor of the Adrestian Empire. It currently has about twenty chapters planned and is regularly updated. 

It is my first romhack and my first FEE3, but I nonetheless hope that this is an exciting showcase and I'm looking forward to anyone trying out this hack!

The hack can be found here: https://feuniverse.us/t/fe8-life-of-seiros-4-chapters-done/25600
